title: A Cloud-Edge System for Multimodal Clinical Screening in Resource-Constrained Rural Settings
abstract: arXiv:2608.12745v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Medical AI has demonstrated specialist-level diagnostic accuracy, yet these capabilities remain largely inaccessible in resource-constrained rural settings where bandwidth is scarce, compute is limited, and clinical decision-making requires integrating heterogeneous modalities. We introduce a cloud--edge collaborative architecture that addresses these constraints: lightweight, domain-specific models on the edge transform raw medical data into compact structured outputs, while a cloud LLM synthesizes these outputs into clinical summaries. An LLM-based orchestrator dynamically selects diagnostic tools based on patient context, promoting comprehensive modality coverage without processing irrelevant inputs. We evaluate on 20 multimodal clinical cases spanning cardiac, obstetric, trauma, and screening scenarios under three simulated network profiles (500,kbps--5,Mbps). translated_title: 一种面向资源受限农村环境的多模态临床筛查云边系统
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.12745v1 公告类型：新 摘要：医疗人工智能已展现出专家级的诊断准确性，然而这些能力在资源受限的农村环境中仍基本无法获得，因为那里带宽稀缺、计算能力有限，且临床决策需要整合异质模态。我们提出了一种云边协作架构来解决这些限制：边缘端的轻量级、领域特定模型将原始医疗数据转换为紧凑的结构化输出，而云端大语言模型将这些输出综合为临床摘要。一个基于大语言模型的编排器根据患者背景动态选择诊断工具，促进全面的模态覆盖，同时避免处理无关输入。我们在涵盖心脏、产科、创伤和筛查场景的20个多模态临床案例中，在三种模拟网络配置（500 kbps至5 Mbps）下进行了评估。该混合系统实现了98–99%的诊断工具召回率和92–96%的预处理准确率。
tldr: 提出了一种云边协作系统，通过边缘端轻量模型转换数据、云端大模型生成摘要及动态工具选择，在低带宽环境中实现高召回率的多模态临床筛查。
en_tdlr: A cloud-edge collaborative system that uses edge lightweight models for data conversion, cloud LLM for summary generation, and dynamic tool selection to achieve high-recall multimodal clinical screening in low-bandwidth settings.
